Definition: Achlai, the name of an Israelitess and of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Ahlai appears twice: a son of Seshan in the genealogy of Judah, and the father of Zabad, one of David's mighty men — one name, two men.
TheologicalSignificance: No doctrine hangs on either Ahlai. The names are kept because the families were kept, and the families mattered because the kingdom was built from them.
